EXTRACT FROM INTELLIGENCE SUMMARY DATED 28/7/31.

Communist Meeting held in Chapei

Some 25 members of the Chapei "District Committee"
of the local Chinese Communist Party held a meeting
between 9 a.m. and 3 p.m. July 26 and passed the following
resolutions :-

1. That three picketing groups each consisting of 20 persons
be organized and despatched to the scene of a proposed
demonstration (venue at present unknown) to be held
on International Red Day (August 1).

2. That the comrade, who has recently returned from
Moscow, where he has been studying for the past
two years, and who is at present head of the
Organization Department in Chapei, be detailed
to conduct demonstrators on International Red
Day, the dissemination of handbills and shouting
of slogans.

3. That arrangements be made to provide relief to the
families of the eleven persons who were arrested
for communist activities in Hongkew and Central
Districts on July 22, 1931.

Sir,
Some 25 members of the Chapei "District Committee"
of the local Chinese Communist Party held a meeting in a
dwelling house (number unknown) near Chun San Bridge (中山桥),
Chun San Road (中山路), Chapei, between 9 a.m. and 3 p.m.
July 26 and passed the following resolutions :-
1) That three Picketing Groups each consisting of
20 persons be organized and despatched to the scene of a
proposed demonstration (location at present unknown) to be
held on International Red Day (August 1).
2) That Tien Yoong-dau (钱永涛), who has recently
returned from Moscow, where he has been studying for the
past two years, and who is at present head of the Organization
Department in Chapei, be detailed to conduct the
demonstrators on International Red Day regarding the
dissemination of handbills and shouting of slogans.
3) That arrangements be made to provide relief
to the families of the eleven persons who were arrested for
communist activities in Hongkew and Central Districts on
July 22, 1931.
The meeting was presided over by Kao Zing Ming
(高静明), Secretary of the Chapei District Committee, who
made the following report on the activities of the Red Army:-
a) General Shih Yeu-shan, who has revolted
against Chiang Kai-shek and Chang Hsueh-liang, has
surrendered himself to the control of Paung Teh-huai
(彭德懷), Commander of the 3rd Group Army of the Red
Forces, who is at present believed to be in Western Kiangsi.
b) On July 24 General Yu Yah-chun of the Nationalist
